content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6-2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. That range is where the muscle-building benefit levels off. Spread it over 3-4 meals, with roughly 0.3-0.4 g/kg each, and keep your total calories at or slightly above maintenance. 💪

If you tell me your bodyweight, I'll work out your daily number.
